name: Settlement Rate Source 1
definition: Specifies the components of a settlement rate source for a non delvierable trade.

RateSource.name: Rate Source
RateSource.definition: Specifies the rate source for the non deliverable trade.

Time.name: Time
Time.definition: Specifies the time "HHMM" associated with the rate source.

CountryCode.name: Country Code
CountryCode.definition: Specifies the country code for the quoted rate source.

LocationCode.name: Location Code
LocationCode.definition: The location expressed as a 2 character code.

TimeCountryLocationRule.definition: Time, Country and Location must be present together or not present at all.
